specimen.heading: Събота, 26 септември
specimen.body: Лозенец, ул. „Червена стена“ 14, вход Б, ет. 3. Звънецът е на Петрови. Паркирайте в двора зад блока, до детската площадка.
specimen.label: Аниматор: Ива Колева

screens.label: Order inbox
screens.requirement: Site orders arrive in one inbox.

screens.label: Bookings and deposits
screens.requirement: Owner can see when a deposit is missing, with a clear red warning. Shows the booked parties with their times, animators and deposit state.

screens.label: Leave requests
screens.requirement: Animators request leave; the owner approves it.

screens.label: Customers
screens.requirement: The owner can find customer history, repeat families, large orders, and upcoming birthdays.

screens.label: My parties
screens.requirement: Each animator sees correct party times and a usable address. The animator can see when a deposit is missing, with a clear red warning.

screens.label: My leave
screens.requirement: Animators request leave; the owner approves it.

screens.label: My pay
screens.requirement: Animators can see their own pay so month end checking takes less manual work.

statusMeaning.danger: Only a missing deposit on a booked party. Nothing else is red.
statusMeaning.warning: Needs the owner soon: a party without an animator, an animator booked twice at once, leave that overlaps booked parties, an address that is not usable, a new order not yet answered.
statusMeaning.ok: Confirmed: deposit received, animator assigned, leave approved.

references.title: Weekly schedule by area
references.note: Pass 1 (task). Learn: open shifts sit in their own row above people, and the footer legend counts every state (warnings, leave pending). Don't copy the pastel-green shift blocks or the spreadsheet grid for a product with 3 to 10 parties a day.

references.title: Inbox with request, approve and details
references.note: Pass 1 (task). Learn: list, the request itself, then structured details (status, assignee, dates, contact) beside it, with Decline and Approve at the foot of the request. Don't copy the three thin grey columns; a site order is a form, not an email thread.

references.title: Customer profile
references.note: Pass 1 (task). Learn: a summary strip (amount spent, orders, customer since, segment) above the last order and a timeline. Don't copy the money-first strip; PartyFox figures are unset, so lead with parties, children and next birthday.

references.title: Event with map and address
references.note: Pass 1 (task). Learn: time block first, then a map tile and a tappable address, then the contact person. Don't copy the stacked grey cards; an animator needs entrance, floor and parking notes, not a meeting link.

references.title: Earnings for one day
references.note: Pass 1 (task). Learn: one total, then plain rows of start time, end time and counts a worker can check line by line. Don't copy the large dollar total; PartyFox pay amounts are unset until the owner supplies the animator cut.

references.title: Concerts list
references.note: Pass 2 (finish). Learn: the small calendar-page date tile (month over a big day number) that makes dates scannable in a list. Don't copy the photo-heavy cards or the red filter pills; red is reserved for a missing deposit.

references.title: Community events
references.note: Pass 2 (finish). Learn: a large confident display headline with generous space, and outlined cards with one strong border instead of shadows. Don't copy the monospace body text or the stock illustration.

references.title: Progress list
references.note: Pass 2 (finish). Learn: warmth from a friendly rounded type and a colored icon tile per row, while the list itself stays calm and readable. Don't copy the game art or the teal background; this is a work tool for adults.

references.title: Income v Expense report
references.note: Pass 2 (finish). Learn: right-aligned tabular numbers, group headers with subtotals, and totals set apart by weight, not color. Don't copy the dense navy sidebar.
